name: vouchrank
description: White-label, multi-tenant reputation and AI-search-optimization (AIO/GEO) SaaS for local businesses: compliant review funnel, LLM-visibility audits (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity), embeddable widgets, Stripe billing. React + Vite + Supabase (Postgres RLS, 12 Deno edge functions). Clickable demo on mock data.

paragraphs: ▶ Live demo: vouchrank.vercel.app · fully clickable on mock data, no signup required.
A multi-tenant, white-label reputation platform that helps local businesses get recommended by AI search engines; built compliant with 2026 review regulations.

Marketing agencies use VouchRank to collect reviews (Google, video, and text) through a branded funnel, measure how often ChatGPT / Gemini / Perplexity recommend their clients, turn praise into social content, and embed social-proof widgets; all under their own brand.
features: 🤖 AI-Search (AIO/GEO) audit: scores how often a business is recommended by
LLMs for local-intent queries, with an optimization checklist.
🎥 Compliant review funnel: every customer gets the same options (Google /
video / text review + private feedback); in-browser video capture; consent built in.
🎨 Review → social graphics — one-click branded PNGs from canvas.
